commands:
for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto -j f2b-nagios
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-nagios
<iptables> -X f2b-nagios

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto -j f2b-nagios
done; done

files.jail.local:
[DEFAULT]
bantime = 2h
maxretry = 2
banaction_allports = nftables[type=allports]
[nagios]
enabled = true
backend = pyinotify
bantime = -1
action = iptables-allports[name=%(__name__)s]
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=rbl]
port = http,https

stderr: fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING Have not found any log file for 'nagios' jail.
